item.title: Quantra - A Superscalar CPU in Turing Complete
item.description: Quantra is a CPU that I built in the logic simulator Turing Complete. It is based on the Allegro architecture that the campaign teaches you, but is heavily modified from this baseline.

item.title: Documentation of Professor348.github.io
item.description: This post’s purpose is to document the development of this website. as a sort of reference for me to look back on, and for other people to gain inspiration from in their own projects. In it, you will find links to all the resources and softwares that I used to build and host this site. In addition, you will find some of the external learning resources that I used throughout the development of this site.
